verdicts.reason: A: the headline wraps and leaves 'longer' alone on the second line, the 'Longest Day Sale' badge is shrunk to a tiny tilted chip squeezed into the bottom-left corner under the logo, the can is a postage-stamp, and the CTA almost touches the right edge. B has the same orphaned headline and cramped CTA but is worse: the logo is a barely visible speck tucked under the can, the badge runs off the left edge, and the legal line wraps to two lines and sits jammed under the headline. So the brand and the reading order break down more in B.
